card.name: Two parties in a mutual relationship
card.fires_on: Words right after a pair of people, groups or countries has been introduced, where the next words describe what they do to each other. Examples are "Both", "each ... the other", "between the two" and "relations between the two countries".

modes.description: Words inside a phrase about relations or marriage between two countries, classes or sexes.

modes.label: Shared or reciprocal verbs
modes.description: Verbs or pronouns tied to a pair of parties, such as sharing a destiny or one denouncing the other.
modes.example: El Perú y Chile, pese a las diferencias históricas, comp<<arten>> un destino común.

card.writes: It pushes against words meaning both sides, each other or mutual, and slightly favors external or internal.
card.plain: It marks spots where two parties are being talked about together and their dealings with each other are about to be described.
